about: The arguments Claude Code (2.1.296, claude-opus-5-5, -p, --permission-mode manual, --permission-prompt-tool mcp__postbox__permission_prompt) sent to Postbox’s permission_prompt tool in the turn recorded in permission-subagent.jsonl: the agent’s own Bash call, then a general-purpose subagent’s. Neither carries permission_suggestions or an agent id. The first was answered { behavior: allow, updatedInput: { command: "echo edited > note.txt" } } and the file then held “edited”; the second { behavior: allow, updatedInput } as asked.
